title: An Interactive GraphRAG Workspace for Reifying, Auditing, and Steering Conversational AI Memories
title_zh: 面向对话式AI记忆的具体化、审计与引导的交互式GraphRAG工作区

paragraphs.en: CognitiveCanvas将对话式AI的记忆转化为可操作、可审计的持久知识图谱，实现token大幅压缩、时效漂移审计与可视化提示引导。 Conversational Large Language Models (LLMs) are widely employed in software engineering for code generation, debugging, and architectural design. However, as developers engage in multi-session development tasks, technical knowledge becomes siloed in isolated, linear chat histories. Reusing context across sessions leads to three critical challenges: (1) flat-vector retrieval fails to traverse multi-hop relational dependencies between distant architectural decisions; (2) temporal drift in software packages and APIs results in silent context poisoning when reusing aged dialogue logs; and (3) raw conversation concatenation induces prompt bloat and attention degradation. We present CognitiveCanvas, an interactive tool that transforms conversational AI memories from ephemeral text logs into persistent, manipulable, and audited knowledge objects. \textsc{CognitiveCanvas} integrates: (1) a Hierarchical Semantic Fact-Graph (HSFG) that distills dialogues into Goal, Fact, and Code artifacts, achieving a 92.2\% token reduction while enabling multi-hop GraphRAG traversal; (2) a Continuous Temporal Drift Auditor coupling 60+ regex heuristics with live calendar-anchored LLM verification for 1-click self-correction; and (3) a Spatial-Symbolic Prompt Compiler (SSPC) that translates 2D direct manipulation gestures (Voronoi clustering, node resizing, synthesis edges) directly into structured attention directives
paragraphs.zh: CognitiveCanvas将对话式AI的记忆转化为可操作、可审计的持久知识图谱，实现token大幅压缩、时效漂移审计与可视化提示引导。对话式大语言模型（LLM）被广泛应用于软件工程中的代码生成、调试与架构设计。 然而，随着开发者进行多会话开发任务，技术知识被割裂在孤立、线性的聊天历史中。 跨会话复用上下文会带来三大关键挑战：（1）扁平向量检索无法遍历相距较远的架构决策之间的多跳关系依赖；（2）软件包与API的时效漂移会在复用陈旧对话日志时导致静默的上下文污染；（3）原始对话拼接会引发提示膨胀与注意力退化。 我们提出CognitiveCanvas，一个将对话式AI记忆从临时文本日志转化为持久、可操作且经审计的知识对象的交互式工具。\textsc{CognitiveCanvas}集成了：（1）分层语义事实图（HSFG），将对话提炼为Goal、Fact与Code工件，在支持多跳GraphRAG遍历的同时实现92.2%的token压缩；（2）持续时效漂移审计器，将60多条正则启发式规则与基于实时日历锚定的LLM验证相结合，实现一键自校正；（3）空间-符号提示编译器（SSPC），将二维直接操纵手势（Voronoi聚类、节点缩放、合成边）直接转化为结构化注意力指令。
